description: Source file implementing DNS configuration watcher for macOS, utilizing dynamic loading of system DNS info symbols and providing functions to monitor DNS configuration changes and validate DNS settings.

classes.name: DnsInfoApi
classes.description: Encapsulates dynamic loading of DNS configuration functions from system libraries.

classes.name: DnsConfigTDeleter
classes.description: Custom deleter for dns_config_t objects, calling the appropriate free function.

methods.name: GetDnsInfoApi
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of DnsInfoApi with loaded DNS functions.

methods.name: DnsConfigWatcher::Watch
methods.description: Sets up a watcher for DNS configuration changes, invoking callback on change.

methods.name: DnsConfigWatcher::CheckDnsConfig
methods.description: Checks current DNS configuration for unhandled options, returning success status.
